fixes.answer: That is an interesting question. I would argue that media figures have a wider reach, but real-life role models, like a parent or mentor, have a far deeper and more [[lasting impact]]. The influence of a media personality is often [[superficial]] and [[fleeting]], whereas someone you interact with daily shapes your character in a much more meaningful way.
fixes.why: 'meaningful' is not advanced; marked 'lasting impact' as a collocation and 'fleeting'
